name: new30__steel_energy
description: Predict 15-minute energy usage from calendar and strictly past electrical measurements (lag1, usage lag4/96). Exclude same-time CO2, reactive power, power factors, and Load_Type because of target-proxy risk. Causal lags computed on chronological source; outer partitions chronological; missing early lags retained for train-only imputation. Use the frozen split; never access test labels or refit on validation.
